items.title: Releasing the full suite of application APIs
items.summary: Web search, file input, URL reading, voice and a safety check are now available to developers through the existing APIs, plus standalone Search and Fetch, OCR, ASR and TTS APIs.

items.title: Opening up the in-house search API
items.summary: DeepSeek's own web search engine is now available through an API.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 update
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is upgraded with better benchmark scores. The API name deepseek-flash and the pricing stay the same.
